xs.$description: The smallest buttons: a Button with size xs, such as Copy under a reply (Inbox T5 346:6404, 22 in Figma, on the 4 px grid). Not for inputs or touch targets on phone and tablet.

xl.$description: Sheet rows, full-width phone buttons and the rows of a large menu, such as the Inbox Snooze menu (D12 346:5303).

sm.$description: A kind tile in a row.

lg.$description: A kind tile in a header.

width.$description: Width of the grabber bar at the top of a bottom sheet or drawer.

height.$description: Height of the grabber bar at the top of a bottom sheet or drawer.

rail.$description: Width of the desktop nav rail.

tabBar.$description: Height of the tablet and phone tab bar, with the home-indicator area.

tabGroup.$description: Width of the centred tab group of the tablet tab bar (TabBar size tablet): Toolkit T01 424:3864 to 424:3899 and Inbox T1 346:5575 to 346:5605, x 150 to 606 of the 756 px frame, shared equally by five or six tabs. Not for the phone tab bar, whose tabs share the whole width, or for a pane or a dialog.

listPane.$description: Width of a list pane: Inbox, Artifacts and Toolkit.

sidebar.$description: Width of the Workbench sidebar and the file tree.

sidePane.$description: Width of the Workbench side chat.

widePane.$description: Width of the Workbench subagents pane.

popoverXs.$description: Width of the Workbench skill picker, the short list of skills a composer opens after "/" (Workbench D1 105:406). Not for a menu or a filter, which is at least popoverSm (240).

submenu.$description: Width of a menu's submenu, the list that opens beside a row such as Move to workspace (Workbench D1 105:473). Not for a menu a button opens, which is at least popoverSm (240).

popoverSort.$description: Width of a menu whose choices have a description line, such as the Inbox Sort menu (D9 346:4000). Not for a popover of controls, which takes popover (320).

popoverFilter.$description: Width of the Inbox Filter menu (D4 346:1737). Other filter and snooze popovers take popover (320).

popover.$description: Width of a filter or snooze popover.

popoverPicker.$description: Width of the Run in picker (Inbox D3 346:1234). Not for the Workbench side chat, which takes sidePane.

dialogLg.$description: Width of the New chat dialog.

dialogWide.$description: Width of a dialog that shows a long text to read, such as the Inbox suggested prompt (D8 346:3543). Not for a confirm dialog or a form.

detail.$description: Most content width of a detail column, such as the Inbox task (D1 346:306). Use it through Container size detail; not for a pane or a dialog.

safeAreaBottom.$description: Bottom padding for the phone home indicator.
